cases.customer_question: Does the 'TCW used for Consistency Check error' message on the review page prevent qualification submission?
question_variants: TCW used for Consistency Check error meaning
Can I submit with a TCW warning?
Is the review page error a blocker?
cases.actual_issue: The qualification review page displayed a warning indicating that a Test Case Waiver was involved in Consistency Check processing, creating concern about whether submission was allowed.
cases.plain_english_explanation: A warning appeared during final qualification review. The customer needed to know whether the registration could still be submitted or whether the warning indicated a qualification failure. The issue was understanding the meaning of the message rather than correcting a technical problem.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that the warning reflected the use of an accepted Test Case Waiver within the qualification process. The message did not prevent submission and the registration could proceed to Submission despite the warning being displayed.
cases.decision_logic: A review-page warning associated with an accepted TCW does not automatically indicate qualification failure. If the waiver has been accepted within the qualification workflow, submission may still be permitted.
cases.final_recommendation: Verify that the TCW is properly incorporated into the qualification record and proceed with submission if the review page allows advancement.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Treating the warning as a hard failure can unnecessarily delay qualification submission and project completion.
